prs.location: U Carton is on the edge of Maynooth Town, directly opposite Carton Retail Park, with a large Tesco outlet and a variety of other convenience shops and restaurants. Maynooth main street is lined with a growing selection of eateries and bars that have earned the prestigious Purple Flag recommendation, in recognition of the area’s vibrancy as a night-time location. The iconic four-star hotel, Carton House, (a 5 minute drive from U Maynooth) has two championship golf courses, while there are also GAA, soccer and rugby clubs in the area. There are four primary and three secondary schools in the town, plus of course the University. At second level there is a new education campus under development, which will introduce two new 1,000 pupil schools and Shared Sports Facility to the area. Transport links are also excellent; a fast and regular train service (only a short walk from the development) takes commuters straight into Dublin city centre, Connolly Station,  in only 45 minutes, while the N4 motorway ensures that motorists can access the M50 and the city centre quickly and conveniently.

description:
3 bed duplex located in the vibrant town of Maynooth. Carton Grove Place is a superb living environment, set amidst attractively landscaped and contemporary gardens that will benefit from year-round colour, and is right on the door step of Maynooth Town which offers a full array of amenities including Shopping and leisure facilities such as Carton Retail Park and the iconic Carton House Estate to name a few. Maynooth is well serviced by transport links with the M4 only a few minutes drive away and local train station only a short stroll from Carton Grove Place. All homes in Carton Grove are built to the highest possible standards, A energy rated,and each resident will enjoy the warmth and space of this stunning development. Location: Carton Grove Place is nestled between the town centre and the iconic Carton House Estate. Just 100m to Carton Retail Park and 600m to the town centre. The M4 is located just 3km from Carton Grove Square allowing access to Dublin Airport and Dublin city with 30 minutes. The No. 66 Dublin Bus service travels directly from Dublin city centre to Maynooth with over 30 trips each day Monday to Friday and frequent weekend services. Irish Rail also provides quick access to the city centre with several journeys per hour from Maynooth railway station, which is only a short distance.

*Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search. No pets allowed, photos for reference only*
